name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-lint-browser-floor
description: The browser floor equin's browser code supports (Chrome/Edge 111, Firefox 115, Safari and iOS Safari 16.4 — every browser from March 2023 on), and browser-floor/no-api-above-floor: a type-aware rule that refuses, in browser-built code, a built-in the TypeScript lib declares but MDN's browser-compat-data says a floor browser lacks (URL.canParse, Set.prototype.union, Promise.withResolvers, …).
